content: Consult your friend on all things, especially on those which respect yourself.
author: Seneca
story:
Having survived eight years of political exile on the barren island of Corsica and the volatile, lethal court of Emperor Nero, Seneca understood the fragility of fortune and the necessity of philosophical armor. Writing to his companion Lucilius, he urged immediate, courageous living over anxious anticipation of future disasters.

Exploring the mysteries of human connection, Seneca saw that genuine fulfillment cannot be hoarded or manufactured through egoic control. It blossoms only when we lower our defenses, dissolve self-importance, and meet the world with openhearted generosity.
reflectionPrompt: How can you extend greater compassion to yourself for your own imperfections right now?
